resources.string: What this TV\'s remote sends, and what the TV can play. Handy when you write a tv.json, map a button or file a bug.
Press any button on the remote. Press Back twice to leave.
Home and Power never reach apps. A button that shows nothing here is taken by the system or by an accessibility helper first. Volume keys still change the volume.
The same lines are in logcat: tools/tv.py \'logcat -d -s TvInspector\'
